          have : r < 3 := hr
          fin_cases r <;> norm_num

      have := (Nat.ModEq.mul_left_cancel (by decide : ((2 ^ 3) ^ k : ℕ) % 7 ≠ 0) ?_)

          have : ((2 ^ 3) % 7) = (1 : ℕ) := by norm_num
          simpa [this] using Nat.one_mod _

      have : (2 ^ r) % 7 = 1 := by
        simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
      fin_cases r <;> norm_num at this

      simpa [hr, this, Nat.mul_comm]⟩

theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro h
  have hmod : (2 ^ n : ℕ) ≡ (-1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 7] := by
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = ((2 ^ n) % 7 + 1 % 7) % 7 := by
        simpa [Nat.add_mod] using rfl
      simpa [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd h, Nat.mod_one, Nat.mod_self] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (7 - 1) % 7 := by norm_num
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
  have hpow : (2 ^ (n % 3) : ℕ) % 7 = 6 := by
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by
      have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_mul_add_div n 3).symm
      calc
        (2 ^ n) % 7
            = (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3) + n % 3)) % 7 := by simpa [hdecomp]
        _ = ((2 ^ 3) ^ (n / 3) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

        _ = ((2 ^ 3) % 7) ^ (n / 3) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7) % 7 := by
              simpa [Nat.mod_mul_left_mod, Nat.mod_pow]
        _ = (1 : ℕ) ^ (n / 3) * (2 ^ (n % 3) % 7) % 7 := by norm_num
        _ = (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 := by

                have : (1 : ℕ) ^ (n / 3) = (1 : ℕ) := by simpa using one_pow (n / 3)
                simpa [this, one_mul])
    simpa [this] using hmod
  have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 6 := hpow
  fin_cases n % 3 <;> norm_num at this
